recipes.label: Prepare a sermon on a secret doctrine, to give to a fervent congregation
recipes.startdescription: The congregation is already in a state of excitement. Any secret knowledge will almost certainly drive them to exultation.
recipes.description: At last their virality is spent.  What have they made of this night? [virality and Lore together will almost always cause Exultation, but will use up the virality.]

recipes.label: Prepare a sermon on a secret doctrine
recipes.startdescription: I will speak to their souls, and if I speak with precision, their souls may answer me. [Using a suitable doctrine with Health preaching is more likely to create virality.]
